# google_vertex_ai_evaluation_set

An EvaluationSet is a collection of related EvaluationItems that are evaluated together
in Vertex AI.


To get more information about EvaluationSet, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.evaluationSets)
* How-to Guides
    * [Official Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/models/evaluation-overview)

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Evaluation Set


```hcl
resource "google_vertex_ai_evaluation_item" "eval-item" {
  region               = "us-central1"
  display_name         = "eval-item"
  evaluation_item_type = "REQUEST"
  evaluation_request {
    prompt {
      text = "hello"
    }
  }
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_evaluation_set" "evaluation_set" {
  region           = "us-central1"
  display_name     = "eval-set"
  evaluation_items = [
    google_vertex_ai_evaluation_item.eval-item.id
  ]
  metadata = jsonencode({
    "env" = "test"
  })
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `display_name` -
  (Required)
  The user-friendly display name for the EvaluationSet.

* `evaluation_items` -
  (Required)
  The EvaluationItems that are part of this EvaluationSet.
  Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/evaluationItems/{evaluationItem}`.

* `region` -
  (Required)
  The region of the EvaluationSet. eg us-central1


* `metadata` -
  (Optional)
  User-defined metadata for this EvaluationSet as a JSON string.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/evaluationSets/{{name}}`

* `name` -
  The short name of the EvaluationSet (the final component of the resource name).

* `create_time` -
  The timestamp of when the EvaluationSet was created in RFC3339 UTC "Zulu" format,
  with nanosecond resolution and up to nine fractional digits.

* `update_time` -
  The timestamp of when the EvaluationSet was last updated in RFC3339 UTC "Zulu" format,
  with nanosecond resolution and up to nine fractional digits.

## Import


EvaluationSet can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/evaluationSets/{{name}}`
* `{{project}}/{{region}}/{{name}}`
* `{{region}}/{{name}}`
* `{{name}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import EvaluationSet using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    name = "<-optional value->"
    region = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_vertex_ai_evaluation_set.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import EvaluationSet using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/evaluationSets/{{name}}"
  to = google_vertex_ai_evaluation_set.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), EvaluationSet can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_evaluation_set.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/evaluationSets/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_evaluation_set.default {{project}}/{{region}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_evaluation_set.default {{region}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_evaluation_set.default {{name}}
```
